# NewtonAI

> AI-powered learning OS for students, teachers, and institutions — study tools, classroom workflows, and an institutional dashboard.

NewtonAI turns any document, lecture, or syllabus into structured study material: notes, flashcards, quizzes, mind maps, podcasts, and a grounded AI tutor. For institutions and coaching centers, it provides a full Classroom OS with live sessions, concept checks, attendance, and post-class analytics.
